航空公司和机场管理毕业生、商业飞行员学生和商业航空作家。
选择窄体机机队来承载航空公司完成其计划往往最终会侧重于部分成本提取。航空公司会定期分析精确到千分之一美分的运营数据点，以确定波音 737 或空客 A320 系列是否能产生最有利的底线性能。
营销材料声称具有明显的结构优势，但现实世界的生产线运营却展现出极其平衡的竞争环境。单通道飞机构成了全球航空网络的绝对支柱，占据了全球绝大多数的客运量，并在短途航线上产生稳定的现金流。
这些机队每天飞行多个航段，周转窗口很短，因此，即使每个座位的运营效率出现微小的差异，也可能从根本上改变公司在标准 20 年资产生命周期内的盈利能力。网络规划人员无法纯粹根据独立性能来评估这些平台；相反，他们必须剖析特定的座位密度和波动的资产价值如何在其独特的路线结构中相互作用。
为了准确评估单通道运营的真实商业足迹，航空公司财务部门严重依赖每可用座位英里成本 (CASM) 作为主要分析基准。这一关键运营指标概述了单个乘客座位飞行一海里（1.85 公里）距离所产生的总支出。
航空公司通常使用这一指标将燃油、机组人员工资和保险费等巨额支出减少到一个单一的单位，从而使执行董事会能够直接衡量机身产生容量的效率。当应用于高频网络时，CASM 充当残酷的均衡器，打破制造商的夸张说法并突出现实世界的运营效率。
线路效率的微小偏差，例如局部路线延误或替代高海拔巡航路线，都会直接影响高频每日时间表的每个座位成本结构。例如，如果一架飞机的空重稍重或布局限制了总载客量，则每天运营 10 次往返的航空公司将见证座位英里成本的巨大变化。
因此，网络规划者需要专门设计其机舱配置，以抑制这种小数点波动，并使所选窄体飞机始终在其最佳成本窗口内运行。管理这个单位成本方程需要企业规划者平衡高度可变的费用和结构性所有权成本。
虽然燃油和工时维护等直接运营变量随着飞机在空中飞行的每一小时而不断变化，但租赁付款和偿债等固定拥有成本的绝对值保持不变。因此，随着航空公司增加每日飞机利用率，将这些固定义务分散到更大的座位里程上，CASM 的资本成本部分急剧下降。
评估单位经济方程的资本组成部分表明，公共制造商目录价格与私人市场交易之间存在财务脱节。原始设备制造商经常发布虚高的标价，作为基准谈判标记，而不是实际交易价值
对于航空公司财务部门来说，关键指标从来不是理论标价，而是将资产纳入公司资产负债表所需的实际资本布局。波音为其 737 MAX 8 制定了更高的标价，该飞机的标价约为 1.17 亿美元，而空客 A320neo 的标价为 1.106 亿美元。
然而，现实世界的市场价值完全颠倒了这种关系，几乎全新的空客 A320neo 的市场价值接近 5800 万美元，而类似的 737 MAX 8 的交易价格接近 5200 万美元。这种差异为美国机身提供了较低的每个座位资本成本，使廉价航空公司在大规模机队更新融资时具有明显的优势。
资本成本增量对航空公司的资产负债表产生直接影响，特别是在经济波动或网络利用率下降期间。由于 737 MAX 8 的月度租赁或债务义务在结构上较低，因此航空公司可以停放飞机或减少每日停机时间，与受较高空客租赁费率约束的航空公司相比，其财务压力较小。
资本缓冲使运营商能够更有效地吸收行业衰退，在客座率低于最佳阈值时保护现金储备。对于专注于最大限度地减少固定资产支出的航空公司来说，波音平台的较低市场价值提供了强大的经济盾牌，这对于许多初创公司来说尤其有用。
美国机身在资本资产定价方面具有明显的优势，但在评估热力学燃油燃烧时，操作方程式又回到了欧洲联盟。燃油消耗是所有干线航空公司最大的单一可变费用，通常占直接运营总成本的 30% 以上。
为了抵消这种风险，两家制造商都推出了具有超高涵道比的下一代动力装置，旨在从每一滴喷气燃油中榨取最大能量。在相同飞行条件下比较这两个平台时，空客 A320neo 在每座燃油效率方面表现出微小但高度一致的优势。
欧洲窄体飞机每个座位每 62 英里消耗约 0.594 美制加仑（每 100 公里 2.25 升），而 737 MAX 8 每个座位每 62 英里消耗约 0.602 美制加仑（每 100 公里 2.28 升）。换算成标准航空指标，A320neo 的每座效率等级可达每加仑 0.682 海里（每升 0.334 公里），略高于 737 的每加仑 0.676 海里（每升 0.331 公里）。
这些微小的分数增量在单个航段中可能显得无关紧要，但它们会在整个干线机队运营中产生巨大的财务支出变化。在每个机身包含 3,000 个阻塞小时的标准年度计划中，这一微小的燃油优势可以为操作员在每个机身上节省数万加仑的燃油。
对于任何管理着一百架飞机的子机队的大型航空公司来说，这种效率差距直接转化为每年数百万美元的节省。这些数字有助于解释为什么空客平台仍然受到运营长航程航线的传统网络航空公司的青睐，其中燃油优化在 CASM 计算中占主导地位。

title_en: Is The World's Best Low-Cost Airline Really That Good? My Experience After Dozens Of Flights
title_zh: 世界上最好的低成本航空公司真的那么好吗？我数十次飞行后的经历
summary: AirAsia is arguably one of the best low-cost carriers in Southeast Asia, offering hassle-free, affordable regional travel.
summary_zh: 亚洲航空可以说是东南亚最好的低成本航空公司之一，提供无忧无虑、价格实惠的区域旅行。
body_en: Aaron is an aviation enthusiast and world traveler with a deep interest in aerospace history and technology. He has traveled around the world numerous times, often incorporating visits to aviation museums and historic aircraft collections into his journeys. A native of New Zealand, he is an expert in aviation and maintains a broad interest in a variety of other subjects.

Having been based in Southeast Asia over the last few years, I have flown with the AirAsia group (legally AirAsia Berhad) dozens of times. The AirAsia group includes its subsidiaries AirAsia Cambodia, Thai AirAsia, and Indonesia AirAsia. The group's structure is somewhat complicated and confusing, with further restructuring and renaming in July 2026. AirAsia X, along with Thai AirAsia X, generally operates longer-haul routes mostly with the group's widebody A330s, although they also have A321s in their inventories.

I have mostly flown with AirAsia, AirAsia X, Thai AirAsia, and likely others. The group's subsidiaries are legally separate airlines, with AirAsia operating under the code AK and AirAsia X under the code D7. For the purposes of this review, all airlines of the AirAsia Group will be treated as a single airline. The core AirAsia brand operates from its hub at Terminal 2 of Malaysia's Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KLIA2) .

AirAsia is somewhat remarkable as it is a low-cost airline but it receives an international ranking comparable to, and even above, many of the world's mainline carriers. In Skytrax's 2026 review of world airlines, AirAsia ranked as the best low-cost airline and the 26th-best overall airline in the world. This put it only modestly behind its full-service flag-carrier rival, Malaysia Airlines, at 21st. It is only one place below the top-ranked US-based airline, Delta Air Lines, at 25th. United Airlines trails at 45th, Alaska Airlines at 51st, and JetBlue at 54th.

Passengers and readers can decide whether they agree with that ranking. I have no issue with AirAsia as a low-cost and regional airline, but placing it alongside the world's mainline carriers seems a bit far-fetched. The standard economy class fare does not include checked baggage, and carry-on baggage is limited to just 15 lbs (7kg).

While US-based carriers may charge more for checked baggage, they typically have no weight limit for carry-on baggage. In the US, carry-on baggage is typically defined by size, not weight. Carry-on trolley suitcases are weighed before emigration; backpacks are generally waived through. Upgrading the fare to include checked baggage is generally best done with AirAsia's bundle option, which includes a complimentary meal and seat selection. AirAsia meals are reasonably decent for a low-cost carrier.

AirAsia is based at Kuala Lumpur's (KL) Terminal 2. Full-service airlines, Malaysia Airlines, and long-haul flights operate through Terminal 1 . The two terminals are connected by airport transportation, but you can't walk between them. Terminal 2 connects KL with domestic airports across Malaysia and with international destinations across Southeast Asia and beyond.

Terminal 2 is unusual because it includes a reasonably large shopping mall adjacent to the building, even though the airport is far outside the city. This lets passengers dine affordably at a range of restaurants and shop before checking in. In many airports I have flown through in the world, I have never seen anything quite like it. The mall shops aren't typical airport shops; they are regular shops, including a supermarket.

The taxi pick-up and drop-off are on the mall side, with passengers walking through the mall to reach the terminal. Arriving passengers also pass through the mall to reach transportation from the airport. The express airport train to central Kuala Lumpur is accessed via the mall. AirAsia check-in is generally self-service, with passengers printing their own baggage tags and dropping off their baggage themselves.

I have flown with AirAsia on domestic Malaysia routes and on routes to Indonesia and Vietnam. Between Vietnam and Bangkok, I have flown with its sister airline, Thai AirAsia. I have also flown domestic Thai AirAsia routes within Thailand. Thai flights depart from Bangkok Don Mueang International Airport (DMK), the secondary international airport that mostly serves low-cost and regional flights.

Bangkok's primary international airport is Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK) . In my experience, Don Mueang works well as a gateway to Bangkok and a regional hub. The airport is connected to Bangkok's metro system and is roughly as easy to reach as Suvarnabhumi, located on the other side of the city.

In many ways, Don Mueang functions similarly to KL's Terminal 2 as a low-cost, primarily AirAsia group hub for the country and region. There are some differences. Because Don Mueang is in an urban area, plenty of low-cost accommodation options are located next to the airport, unlike KL. Check-in counters are also staffed, unlike the self-check-in kiosks in KL's Terminal 2.
Southeast Asia Has Multiple Acceptable Low-Cost Airlines

Booking AirAsia fares is seamless through its AirAsia Move app. The app includes the various AirAsia flights and options, as well as flights from a range of other airlines in the region, like VietJet and Singapore Airlines. Personally, I would choose AirAsia flights over VietJet whenever possible. My VietJet flights have been repeatedly delayed, including by a full day, but never for AirAsia.

VietJet's check-in facilities at Ho Chi Minh International Airport (Saigon) are also frequently terrible, with long queues and wait times, though this can be a matter of luck. Vietnam is in the process of building its new Long Thanh International Airport to serve as the primary international gateway, which is expected to significantly improve the situation. The existing Tan Son Nhat International Airport will remain open for domestic and some regional international flights.

Southeast Asia has some other low-cost options, like Indonesia's Citilink and Lion Air, Singapore's Scoot, and even India's IndiGo (not technically Southeast Asia but serving many destinations). All of these low-cost Asian airlines are fine in my experience, and I have flown them without complaint. Low-cost airlines in the region typically operate A320 family aircraft instead of Boeing 737 aircraft , with some exceptions, such as Thailand's modest Nok Air low-cost airline.

According to Planespotters.net , the AirAsia group fleet totals 239 aircraft, all Airbus. AirAsia's website currently puts the figure at 244 aircraft. Planespotters.net's breakdown includes 196 A320s, 20 A321s, and 23 widebody A330s. Thai AirAsia X operates A330-300s with A330-900s on order. AirAsia X operates A330-300s and is taking delivery of new A321neos. The core Malaysia-based AirAsia brand operates around 104 aircraft, Thai AirAsia operates around 62, and most of the rest are operated by Indonesia AirAsia and Philippines AirAsia, with around 23 aircraft each.
body_zh: 亚伦是一位航空爱好者和环球旅行家，对航空航天历史和技术有着浓厚的兴趣。他曾多次环游世界，经常在旅途中参观航空博物馆和历史飞机收藏。他是新西兰人，是航空专家，并对其他各种学科保持着广泛的兴趣。
过去几年，我常驻东南亚，乘坐亚航集团（合法的亚航有限公司）飞行数十次。亚洲航空集团包括其子公司柬埔寨亚洲航空、泰国亚洲航空和印度尼西亚亚洲航空。该集团的结构有些复杂和混乱，并于 2026 年 7 月进行了进一步重组和更名。亚航长途公司和泰国亚航长途公司通常主要使用该集团的宽体 A330 飞机运营长途航线，尽管他们的库存中也有 A321 飞机。
我主要乘坐过亚洲航空、亚洲航空长程、泰国亚洲航空以及其他可能的航班。该集团的子公司是合法独立的航空公司，其中亚洲航空的运营代码为 AK，亚洲航空 X 的运营代码为 D7。出于本次审查的目的，亚航集团的所有航空公司将被视为单一航空公司。亚洲航空的核心品牌以马来西亚吉隆坡国际机场 (KLIA2) 2 号航站楼为枢纽运营。

亚航有些引人注目，因为它是一家低成本航空公司，但它的国际排名与世界上许多干线航空公司相当，甚至更高。在 Skytrax 2026 年全球航空公司评选中，亚航被评为最佳低成本航空公司，并在全球最佳航空公司中排名第 26 位。这使得该公司仅略微落后于提供全方位服务的旗舰航空公司竞争对手马来西亚航空，排名第 21 位。它仅比排名第一的美国航空公司达美航空（排在第 25 位）低一位。联合航空排名第 45 位，阿拉斯加航空排名第 51 位，捷蓝航空排名第 54 位。
乘客和读者可以决定是否同意该排名。我对亚航作为一家低成本支线航空公司没有异议，但将其与世界主要航空公司并列似乎有点牵强。标准经济舱票价不包括托运行李，随身行李仅限 15 磅（7 公斤）。
虽然美国的航空公司可能会对托运行李收取更高的费用，但他们通常对随身行李没有重量限制。在美国，随身行李通常是根据尺寸而不是重量来定义的。随身携带的拉杆行李箱在出境前会进行称重；背包一般都是免过的。升级票价以包含托运行李通常最好选择亚航的捆绑选项，其中包括免费餐食和座位选择。对于一家低成本航空公司来说，亚航的餐食相当不错。
亚洲航空的总部位于吉隆坡 (KL) 2 号航站楼。全服务航空公司、马来西亚航空和长途航班均通过 1 号航站楼运营。两个航站楼之间有机场交通连接，但您不能在它们之间步行。 2 号航站楼将吉隆坡与马来西亚国内机场以及东南亚及其他地区的国际目的地连接起来。
2 号航站楼很不寻常，因为它在大楼附近设有一个相当大的购物中心，尽管机场距离市区很远。这让乘客可以在办理登机手续之前在一系列餐厅和商店以实惠的价格用餐。在我飞过的世界上许多机场中，我从未见过类似的情况。商场里的商店不是典型的机场商店；它们是普通商店，包括超市。
出租车上落客地点位于商场一侧，乘客步行穿过商场即可到达航站楼。到达的旅客也需经过购物中心才能到达机场的交通工具。前往吉隆坡市中心的机场特快列车可通过购物中心抵达。亚航的登机手续通常是自助服务，乘客可以打印自己的行李标签并自行托运行李。
我乘坐过亚航的马来西亚国内航线以及飞往印度尼西亚和越南的航线。我搭乘其姊妹航空公司泰国亚洲航空的航班往返于越南和曼谷之间。我还在泰国境内飞行过泰国亚洲航空的国内航线。泰国航班从曼谷廊曼国际机场 (DMK) 起飞，该机场是二级国际机场，主要提供廉价航班和地区航班。
曼谷的主要国际机场是素万那普机场 (BKK)。根据我的经验，廊曼是通往曼谷的门户和区域枢纽。该机场与曼谷的地铁系统相连，与位于城市另一边的素万那普机场一样容易到达。
在许多方面，廊曼机场的功能与吉隆坡 2 号航站楼类似，都是亚洲航空集团在该国家和地区的低成本枢纽。有一些差异。由于廊曼位于市区，因此与吉隆坡不同，机场旁边有许多廉价住宿选择。与吉隆坡 2 号航站楼的自助值机亭不同，值机柜台也配备了工作人员。
东南亚有多家可接受的低成本航空公司
通过 AirAsia Move 应用程序可以无缝预订亚航票价。该应用程序包括亚洲航空的各种航班和选项，以及该地区其他一系列航空公司的航班，例如越捷航空和新加坡航空。就我个人而言，只要有可能，我会选择亚航而不是越捷航空的航班。我的越捷航空航班多次延误，包括一整天的延误，但亚航的航班从未延误。
越捷航空在胡志明国际机场（西贡）的登机手续办理设施也经常很糟糕，排长队，等待时间长，尽管这可能是运气问题。越南正在建设新的龙城国际机场，作为主要的国际门户，预计这将显着改善这一情况。现有的新山一国际机场将继续对国内和部分地区国际航班开放。

Southeast Asia has some other low-cost options, like Indonesia's Citilink and Lion Air, Singapore's Scoot, and even India's IndiGo (not technically Southeast Asia but serving many destinations).根据我的经验，所有这些低成本的亚洲航空公司都很好，我乘坐它们也没有任何抱怨。 Low-cost airlines in the region typically operate A320 family aircraft instead of Boeing 737 aircraft , with some exceptions, such as Thailand's modest Nok Air low-cost airline.

据 Planespotters.net 报道，亚航集团机队共有 239 架飞机，全部是空中客车公司。亚航网站目前的数字为 244 架飞机。 Planespotters.net 的细分包括 196 架 A320、20 架 A321 和 23 架宽体 A330。泰国亚洲航空长途公司运营 A330-300 飞机，并已订购 A330-900 飞机。亚航长程运营 A330-300 飞机，并正在接收新的 A321neo 飞机。马来西亚亚航核心品牌运营约 104 架飞机，泰国亚航运营约 62 架飞机，其余大部分由印度尼西亚亚航和菲律宾亚航运营，各约 23 架飞机。

title_en: Chase Sapphire Lounge SeaTac Airport Gets Approval, And It Looks Gorgeous
title_zh: 西塔科机场大通蓝宝石休息室获得批准，看起来很华丽
summary: The Port of Seattle has approved a roughly 16,000 square foot Chase Sapphire Lounge at SEA's Concourse A, and the renderings look great, though the opening date is unclear.

body_en: A roughly 16,000 square foot Chase Sapphire Lounge is expected to open at Seattle Tacoma International Airport (SEA). This will require some patience, as the project has just been approved, but it’s at least nice to know that this is on the horizon… hopefully.
Chase Sapphire Lounge Seattle now in the pipeline!

The Port of Seattle has just approved plans for a new Chase Sapphire Lounge at the airport, in partnership with Airport Dimensions, as flagged by View from the Wing . This new lounge will be located in Concourse A, next to the current Delta lounge complex (which has both a Delta One Lounge and SkyClub).

Chase Sapphire Lounges are known for being among the best credit card lounges out there, and feature nice decor, excellent food and drinks, and some other amenities. They’re primarily intended for those who have the Chase Sapphire Reserve or Sapphire Reserve Business , though there are other ways to access these lounges as well.
Based on the presentation about the new lounge, it’ll feature pretty typical Chase Sapphire Lounge amenities, including shower suites, digital food ordering, and more.

The renderings of the Chase Sapphire Lounge Seattle look beautiful, in line with what you’d expect from the network. I must say, the design perhaps looks even more elevated compared to what we typically see, though maybe these renderings are also a bit optimistic.

Just for some context, this lounge will take over the space of the existing Concourse A The Club at SEA, along with an adjacent area that was supposed to be part of the expansion of that lounge. That’s because The Club at SEA will take over the space of the United Club, as that lounge moves to the space of the former Centurion Lounge in Concourse B.

Unfortunately the timeline for the Chase Sapphire Lounge Seattle opening is a mystery as of now. I suspect that absolute best case scenario, we’re looking at a 2028 timeline, and possibly even 2029, just based on how long these kinds of airport projects ordinarily take. This is the third Chase Sapphire Lounge in the pipeline that’s not yet open, as we’ll also see these lounges in Los Angeles (LAX) and Miami (MIA) .
Seattle’s airport lounge situation is improving nicely

Admittedly it has been close to 15 years since I’ve lived in Seattle, but the airport’s lounge situation sure is improving very nicely. I remember when the first Centurion Lounge Seattle opened back in 2015, and it was so small that they branded it as the “Centurion Studio.”

Since then, we’ve of course seen an actually nice and big Centurion Lounge open , we’ve seen the beautiful Alaska Lounge in Concourse N open , and we’ve seen the Delta One Lounge and SkyClub in Concourse A open . Now we’re also going to see another new Alaska lounge complex open (including a first-ever Aurora Lounge, plus Alaska Lounge), and then there’s also a Chase Sapphire Lounge coming. These are all awesome developments!

Seattle Tacoma International Airport is getting a Chase Sapphire Lounge. The project has now been approved, though expect it’ll be at least a couple of years before this lounge opens. The expectation is that the lounge will be around 16,000 square feet, and it’ll be located in Concourse A, next to the existing Delta lounge complex.
This should be a very nice addition to the airport, as it’s always great to see more lounge space added.

body_en: Sky-Watch secures NATO procurement framework for reconnaissance drones - Aviation24.be
Home Organisations NATO Sky-Watch secures NATO procurement framework for reconnaissance drones

Danish drone manufacturer Sky-Watch has been selected under a NATO Support and Procurement Agency (NSPA) framework agreement, enabling participating nations to purchase its RQ-35 Heidrun unmanned aircraft system and associated in-service support.

Awarded through NSPA’s AGS & UAS Programme on behalf of the UAS Partnership, the framework provides member nations with a simplified procurement channel. It does not itself constitute a confirmed aircraft order, and no contract value, quantities or delivery timetable were disclosed.

The RQ-35 Heidrun is an unarmed, fixed-wing system designed for intelligence, surveillance, target acquisition and reconnaissance missions. According to Sky-Watch, it has been deployed in Ukraine and other conflict zones, with portability and resistance to electronic warfare among its principal features.
Chief executive Martin Schousboe said the agreement would help participating NATO nations acquire unmanned capabilities more quickly than through some national procurement procedures.

Sky-Watch, part of US-listed AIRO Group Holdings, is expanding its international activities and production capacity in response to demand for unmanned systems. The company sees the framework as a platform for further growth across NATO markets.

body_en: At least 64 killed in Spanish high-speed train collision near Urda - Aviation24.be
Home Miscellaneous Accidents At least 64 killed in Spanish high-speed train collision near Urda

At least 64 people have died after two high-speed passenger trains collided near Urda, in Spain’s Toledo province, on Wednesday, 28 October. At least 80 people were reported injured as emergency teams searched the wreckage, according to the Associated Press, citing national and regional authorities. The casualty figures remain provisional.

The accident occurred at approximately 08:54 local time at kilometre 118 of the Madrid–Andalusia high-speed line. Infrastructure manager Adif confirmed a rear-end collision involving Renfe AVE train 2080 and Iryo train 6076 serving the Madrid–Seville route.

Initial accounts indicate that the Renfe AVE struck an Iryo train that was stationary, causing two of the latter’s carriages to derail. Regional authorities said 544 passengers were travelling aboard the two services: 397 on the Renfe train and 147 on the Iryo service, including an infant.

Castilla-La Mancha activated its regional emergency plan at 09:15 and raised the response level at 10:30 after requesting assistance from Spain’s Military Emergency Unit. Firefighters, Civil Guard officers, Civil Protection volunteers and medical teams were deployed, supported by medical helicopters and mobile intensive-care units.
Adif said it was examining its systems and the sequence of events to establish what happened. No cause had been identified in its initial account to Spanish news agency EFE.

El País reported preliminary indications of a signalling-system problem followed by an error during manual traffic management, citing government sources. These accounts remain subject to investigation and do not constitute an established finding of responsibility. The trains’ speeds at impact have not been confirmed. EL PAÍS English

High-speed services between Madrid, Ciudad Real and Andalusia were suspended following the collision. Adif established assistance points at Madrid Atocha, Seville Santa Justa, Córdoba and Málaga María Zambrano stations.

Renfe announced free changes and cancellations for affected journeys. No confirmed reopening time was available in the reports reviewed, leaving passengers facing substantial disruption while rescue and investigation work continued.

10 月 28 日星期三，西班牙托莱多省乌尔达附近两列高速客运列车相撞，造成至少 64 人死亡。据美联社援引国家和地区当局的消息称，紧急救援队搜查飞机残骸时，据报道至少有 80 人受伤。伤亡数字仍是临时数字。
事故发生在当地时间上午8时54分左右，地点为马德里-安达卢西亚高速线第118公里处。基础设施经理阿迪夫证实，服务于马德里-塞维利亚路线的 Renfe AVE 2080 号列车和 Iryo 6076 号列车发生追尾事故。
初步报告显示，Renfe AVE 撞上了一辆静止的 Iryo 列车，导致后者的两节车厢脱轨。地区当局表示，这两条线路共有 544 名乘客：Renfe 列车上有 397 名乘客，Iryo 列车上有 147 名乘客，其中包括一名婴儿。
卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰于9点15分启动了地区应急计划，并在向西班牙军事应急部队请求援助后于10点30分提高了响应级别。在医疗直升机和移动重症监护室的支持下，部署了消防员、国民警卫队官员、民防志愿者和医疗队。
阿迪夫表示，它正在检查其系统和事件的顺序，以确定发生了什么。西班牙埃菲通讯社最初的报道中并未指出原因。
《国家报》援引政府消息人士的话称，初步迹象表明信号系统存在问题，随后在人工交通管理过程中出现错误。这些账户仍在接受调查，并不构成已确定的责任认定。火车受影响时的速度尚未得到证实。国家报 英语
事故发生后，马德里、雷阿尔城和安达卢西亚之间的高速服务暂停。阿迪夫在马德里阿托查站、塞维利亚圣胡斯塔站、科尔多瓦站和马拉加玛丽亚赞布拉诺站设立了援助点。
Renfe 宣布对受影响的旅程进行免费变更和取消。审查的报告中没有确定重新开放的时间，导致乘客在救援和调查工作继续进行的同时面临严重干扰。

title_en: Qatar Airways’ New “Private Jet” First Class Has Gone From Definite To Maybe
title_zh: 卡塔尔航空全新“私人飞机”头等舱已从确定变为可能
summary: Qatar Airways' new CEO says a new first class is "under serious design," but only if it's worthwhile. That's a big shift from the previous CEO's commitment.
summary_zh: 卡塔尔航空新任首席执行官表示，新的头等舱正在“认真设计”，但前提是值得。这与前任首席执行官的委员会相比有很大转变
body_en: It sounds like Qatar Airways is no longer committed to introducing a new first class product. I guess this is what happens when you go through three CEOs in three years, as we’ve gone from “definitely no new first class,” to “definitely a new first class,” to “maybe a new first class.”
Qatar Airways’ premium focus has long been on business class

Qatar Airways is known for its world-class Qsuites business class , which is among the best in the world . So while Gulf rivals like Emirates have continued to lean heavily into offering first class, Qatar Airways has instead focused on business class. Currently, the airline only offers long haul first class on two aircraft types
All Airbus A380s , which the airline intended to retire during the pandemic, but brought back due to the dispute the company had with Airbus
A few Boeing 777s , which Qatar Airways picked up from Cathay Pacific, so the airline just maintained the cabins installed on those jets
On top of that, the airline markets its forward cabin on many regional flights as first class , though in terms of seating, that’s truly business class.

However, there has long been talk of whether we could see Qatar Airways introduce first class on its upcoming Boeing 777Xs. The airline has 60 Boeing 777-9s on order , and this will eventually become Qatar Airways’ flagship aircraft.
The 777-9 is a big plane, so it gives airlines a lot of space to play with, so it’s not surprising that several airlines plan to introduce a revolutionary first class product on this plane.

I’ve written in the past about how Cathay Pacific is planning a new first class for its Boeing 777-9s. While it’s anyone’s guess if this ends up being the case, there have been rumors that it could look something like Butterfly’s Peacock Suites concept. Only time will tell how that plays out, but it certainly does create a private jet-like experience.
Qatar Airways goes back and forth on 777X first class

Akbar Al Baker was Qatar Airways’ longtime CEO, until 2023, when he suddenly resigned . When Al Baker was CEO, he made it clear that he planned to eliminate first class , claiming that there’s no need for the product, because the carrier’s business class is so good. As he explained
“Why should you invest in a subclass of an aeroplane that already gives you all the amenities that first class gives you. I don’t see the necessity.”

Of course I’d say that’s a bit of a stretch, as this came from the same guy who claimed there was no need for premium economy, because he thought economy on his airline was better than premium economy on other airlines.

Then in 2023, we saw Badr Mohammed Al Meer become Qatar Airways CEO . In March 2024, Al Meer had an interesting interview with CNBC , where he had a very different perspective on first class, claiming the airline was committed to maintaining the cabin, and even developing a new product that was more along the lines of a private jet experience

“We wanted to combine the experience of flying commercial and flying on a private jet and develop something new. We are 70% to 80% ready. We are only finalizing colors and small touches, but hopefully we will be able to announce it very soon.”
Unfortunately Al Meer’s tenure didn’t last long, and in December 2025, he was replaced by Hamad Ali Al‑Khater . Well, it seems that Al-Khater isn’t quite as committed to first class as Al Meer was.

Executive Traveller quotes him as saying that the carrier’s new first class is “under serious design,” but also cautioned that “we’d only do it if we believe we have a first class that’s worthwhile to talk about, and that will be appealing to our customers.”

Okay, so he’s not saying that first class isn’t happening, but he’s also saying that it’s far from a sure bet. We’ve gone from “only finalizing colors and small touches” a couple of years ago, to now saying “we’ll only do it if we believe we have a first class that’s worthwhile to talk about.” In other words, the design process is nowhere close to complete, and no progress has been made over the past couple of years.

One thing is for sure — if Qatar Airways does introduce first class on its upcoming Boeing 777Xs (which will be delivered in late 2027, best case scenario ), it definitely won’t be on the first batch. That’s just not realistic in terms of timeline, so I’d expect it would only be the later batch of these planes that would get first class, if any do at all.

At least on the 777Xs we can look forward to the carrier’s new Qsuites Next Gen business class . That was initially supposed to debut on the 777X, but due to constant delays, it’ll now be installed on newly delivered A350s as of mid-2027.
body_zh: 听起来卡塔尔航空不再致力于推出新的头等舱产品。我想这就是当你在三年内更换三位首席执行官时会发生的情况，因为我们已经从“绝对没有新的一流”，到“肯定有新的一流”，再到“也许有新的一流”。
卡塔尔航空长期以来一直将高端重点放在商务舱上
卡塔尔航空以其世界一流的Qsuites商务舱而闻名，在全球名列前茅。因此，尽管阿联酋航空等海湾竞争对手继续大力提供头等舱，但卡塔尔航空却专注于商务舱。目前，该航空公司仅在两种机型上提供长途头等舱服务
所有空客 A380 飞机，该航空公司原本打算在大流行期间退役，但由于该公司与空客之间的纠纷而重新召回
卡塔尔航空从国泰航空接收的几架波音 777 飞机，因此该航空公司仅维护这些飞机上安装的客舱
最重要的是，该航空公司在许多支线航班上将其前舱定位为头等舱，尽管就座位而言，这是真正的商务舱。
然而，长期以来，人们一直在讨论卡塔尔航空是否会在其即将推出的波音 777X 上推出头等舱。该航空公司已订购 60 架波音 777-9，这最终将成为卡塔尔航空的旗舰飞机。
777-9是一架大飞机，因此给航空公司很大的发挥空间，因此多家航空公司计划在这款飞机上推出革命性的头等舱产品也就不足为奇了。
我过去曾写过有关国泰航空如何为其波音 777-9 飞机规划新头等舱的文章。虽然大家都在猜测最终情况是否如此，但有传言称它可能看起来像蝴蝶的孔雀套房概念。只有时间才能证明结果如何，但它确实创造了类似私人飞机的体验。
卡塔尔航空 777X 头等舱往返
阿克巴尔·阿尔·贝克 (Akbar Al Baker) 长期担任卡塔尔航空首席执行官，直到 2023 年突然辞职。 Al Baker在担任CEO时就明确表示打算取消头等舱，声称不需要这个产品，因为该航空公司的商务舱太好了。正如他所解释的
“你为什么要投资一架飞机的子舱，它已经为你提供了头等舱所提供的所有便利设施。我不认为有必要。”
当然，我想说这有点牵强，因为这来自声称不需要豪华经济舱的同一个人，因为他认为他的航空公司的经济舱比其他航空公司的豪华经济舱更好。
然后在 2023 年，我们看到巴德尔·穆罕默德·阿尔·米尔 (Badr Mohammed Al Meer) 成为卡塔尔航空首席执行官。 2024 年 3 月，Al Meer 接受了 CNBC 的一次有趣采访，他对头等舱有着截然不同的看法，声称航空公司致力于维护机舱，甚至开发了一种更符合私人飞机体验的新产品
“我们希望将商业飞行和私人飞机飞行的体验结合起来，开发一些新的东西。我们已经做好了 70% 到 80% 的准备。我们只是敲定了颜色和一些小改动，但希望我们能够很快宣布。”
不幸的是，阿尔·梅尔的任期并没有持续多久，2025 年 12 月，他被哈马德·阿里·阿尔哈特 (Hamad Ali Al-Khater) 取代。嗯，看来阿尔哈特并不像阿尔梅尔那样致力于头等舱。
《Executive Traveller》援引他的话说，该航空公司的新头等舱正在“认真设计”，但他也警告说，“只有当我们相信我们拥有值得谈论的头等舱，并且对我们的客户有吸引力时，我们才会这样做。”
好吧，他并不是说头等舱不会发生，但他也说这远非板上钉钉的事。我们已经从几年前的“只完成颜色和小细节”，到现在说“只有当我们相信我们拥有值得谈论的一流产品时，我们才会这样做。”换句话说，设计过程还远未完成，并且在过去几年中没有取得任何进展。
有一点是肯定的——如果卡塔尔航空确实在其即将推出的波音 777X 飞机上推出头等舱（最好的情况是，该飞机将于 2027 年末交付），它肯定不会出现在第一批飞机上。从时间安排上来说这是不现实的，所以我预计只有后一批飞机才能获得头等舱（如果有的话）。
至少在 777X 上，我们可以期待该航空公司全新的 Qsuites Next Gen 商务舱。该系统最初应该在 777X 上首次亮相，但由于不断延迟，现在将从 2027 年中期开始安装在新交付的 A350 上。

title_en: Bilt Rent Day Promotion November 2026: Up To $150 Off Hotel, Up To 100% Gift Card Bonus
title_zh: Bilt Rent Day 促销 2026 年 11 月：酒店优惠最高 150 美元，最高 100% 礼品卡奖励
summary: Bilt's November 2026 Rent Day offers double points on purchases, up to a 100% gift card redemption bonus, and up to $150 off a Bilt Travel Portal hotel stay.
summary_zh: Bilt 的 2026 年 11 月租赁日提供双倍购物积分、高达 100% 的礼品卡兑换奖金，以及 Bilt Travel Portal 酒店高达 150 美元的折扣
body_en: Bilt is the platform known for providing rewards for housing payments. Earlier this year we saw massive changes at Bilt , including an overhaul of the credit card portfolio , plus new ways that housing rewards are offered .

There are many innovative things about Bilt, including that there’s a Bilt Rent Day promotion on the first day of each month. With a new month being right around the corner, the details of the November 2026 Bilt Rent Day offer have just been announced, and it includes both a gift card redemption bonus and a hotel booking promo code. While there’s no transfer bonus to a travel program, I imagine this will still interest some.
Details of the November 2026 Bilt Rent Day promotion
There are a couple of aspects to the Bilt Rent Day promotion, including the ability to earn bonus points (which is the same every month), plus at least one additional promotion.
Note that Bilt Rent Day promotions are generally valid from 12:00AM ET until 11:59PM PT, so technically you have around 27 hours to take advantage of them.
Earn double Bilt points on Rent Day purchases

Bilt has a portfolio of credit cards , including the no annual fee Bilt Blue Card ( learn more ), $95 annual fee Bilt Obsidian Card ( learn more ), and $495 annual fee Bilt Palladium Card ( learn more ) ( Rates & Fees ). Personally, I think the Bilt Palladium Card is by far the most lucrative .

On the first day of each month, you earn double those rewards on these cards, and earn up to 1,000 bonus points each month. It could be worth strategically making some purchases on the first day of each month to maximize this as much as possible.

For example, with double points, the Bilt Palladium Card offers 4x points on everyday spending on the first day of the month, so that’s pretty awesome (up to a cap of $500 worth of spending, since that would earn you 1,000 bonus points).
Receive up to a 100% bonus on gift card redemptions
On November 1, 2026 only, Bilt is offering a bonus when members redeem points for gift cards. The bonus you’re eligible for depends on your Bilt elite status , as follows
Bilt Platinum members can receive a 100% bonus
This same bonus is available for all 125+ gift cards that Bilt points can be redeemed for. There’s no option to use Bilt Cash to increase your bonus here.

For what it’s worth, ordinarily Bilt points can be redeemed for 0.7 cents each toward gift card purchases. That means a Blue member would be getting 0.875 cents per point of value, while a Platinum member would be getting 1.4 cents per point of value. For me that’s a hard pass, though I suppose for some Platinum members, it could be an interesting way to “cash out” points, if that’s what you’re looking to do.
Receive a Bilt Travel Portal hotel promo credit

For the November 2026 Bilt Rent Day promotion, we’re actually seeing an additional offer as well. Bilt members can unlock up to $150 off a hotel stay booked in the Bilt Travel Portal during Rent Week, so it’s available for bookings between 9AM ET on October 28 and 3AM ET on November 2, 2026.

The catch here is that different members are eligible for different offers, so members have to log into their Bilt account, and they will see a targeted chart delineating different savings of up to $150 for hotel bookings. Here are the key details

Every member will see a three-tiered “spend and get” offer, allowing them to save up to $150 on a hotel booking made in the Bilt Travel Portal; spend thresholds will vary, but members can unlock $50, $100, or $150 off, by making a qualifying booking
The offer applies to one booking at any property in the Bilt Travel Portal, with no blackout dates or restrictions on length or type of stay
If the booking is canceled during the offer period, the member can use the offer again
body_zh: Bilt 是一个以提供住房付款奖励而闻名的平台。今年早些时候，我们看到比尔特发生了巨大的变化，包括信用卡组合的彻底改革，以及提供住房奖励的新方式。
Bilt 有很多创新之处，包括每个月的第一天都有 Bilt Rent Day 促销活动。新的一个月即将到来，2026 年 11 月 Bilt Rent Day 优惠详情刚刚公布，其中包括礼品卡兑换奖金和酒店预订促销代码。虽然旅行计划没有转会奖金，但我想这仍然会引起一些人的兴趣。
2026 年 11 月 Bilt 租赁日促销详情
Bilt Rent Day 促销有几个方面，包括赚取奖励积分（每个月相同）的能力，以及至少一项额外促销。
请注意，Bilt 租赁日促销活动的有效期通常为东部时间上午 12:00 至太平洋时间晚上 11:59，因此从技术上讲，您有大约 27 小时的时间来利用它们。
在租赁日购买可赚取双倍 Bilt 积分
Bilt 拥有一系列信用卡，包括无年费的 Bilt Blue 卡（了解更多）、年费 95 美元的 Bilt Obsidian 卡（了解更多）和年费 495 美元的 Bilt Palladium 卡（了解更多）（费率和费用）。就我个人而言，我认为比尔特钯金卡是迄今为止最赚钱的。
每个月的第一天，您可以通过这些卡赚取双倍奖励，并每月赚取高达 1,000 点奖励积分。可能值得在每个月的第一天策略性地进行一些购买，以尽可能地最大化这一点。
例如，如果双倍积分，Bilt Palladium 卡在每月第一天的日常消费中提供 4 倍积分，所以这相当棒（最高消费额为 500 美元，因为这将为您赢得 1,000 个奖励积分）。
兑换礼品卡可获得高达 100% 的奖励
仅在 2026 年 11 月 1 日，Bilt 将在会员用积分兑换礼品卡时提供奖励。您有资格获得的奖金取决于您的 Bilt 精英身份，如下
Bilt白金会员可以获得100%的奖金
所有 125 种以上可使用 Bilt 积分兑换的礼品卡均可享受同样的奖励。此处无法使用 Bilt Cash 来增加您的奖金。
就其价值而言，通常每个 Bilt 积分可以兑换 0.7 美分，用于购买礼品卡。这意味着蓝色会员每点价值将获得 0.875 美分，而白金会员每价值点将获得 1.4 美分。对我来说，这是一个困难的过程，但我认为对于一些白金会员来说，如果您想这样做的话，这可能是一种有趣的“兑现”积分的方式。
获得比尔特旅游门户酒店促销积分
对于 2026 年 11 月 Bilt 租赁日促销活动，我们实际上还看到了额外优惠。 Bilt 会员在租赁周期间通过 Bilt Travel Portal 预订酒店住宿可享受高达 150 美元的优惠，因此适用于 10 月 28 日上午 9 点（美国东部时间）至 2026 年 11 月 2 日凌晨 3 点（美国东部时间）之间的预订。
这里的问题是，不同的会员有资格享受不同的优惠，因此会员必须登录他们的 Bilt 帐户，然后他们会看到一个目标图表，其中列出了酒店预订时最多可节省 150 美元的不同优惠。以下是关键细节
每位会员都将看到三级“消费即得”优惠，使他们在 Bilt Travel Portal 预订酒店时最多可节省 150 美元；消费门槛会有所不同，但会员可以通过符合条件的预订获得 50 美元、100 美元或 150 美元的折扣
此优惠适用于比尔特旅游门户网站上任何酒店的一次预订，没有限制日期，也没有住宿时间或类型的限制
若优惠期间取消预订，会员可再次使用该优惠

The Naval Surface Warfare Center Indian Head Explosive Ordnance Disposal Technology Division, Indian Head, Maryland, is the contracting activity. Vector Planning and Services Inc. , San Diego, is being awarded a potential $17,910,070 indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity, cost-plus-fixed-fee contract to provide cyberspace science, research, engineering, and technology integration. Support includes innovative technology assessment and development; rapid software development and prototyping; enabling capability training; security engineering; and cybersecurity risk management. This is one of four multiple-award contracts. All awardees will have the opportunity to compete for task orders during the ordering period. The Space and Naval Warfare Systems Center Pacific, San Diego, is the contracting activity (N66001-17-D-0117). Selected U.S. military contracts for March 9, 2017 U.S. MISSILE DEFENSE AGENCY Lockheed Martin Space Systems Co. , Sunnyvale, California, was awarded a $53,052,807 competitive cost-plus-fixed-fee contract for a 36-month period with no options for the Multi-Object Kill Vehicle Technology Risk Reduction (TRR) effort. The Missile Defense Agency, Huntsville, Alabama, is the contracting activity (HQ0147-17-C-0002). The Capacity as a Service acquisition model allows Spawar to more accurately scale, up and down, its information technology (IT) infrastructure to meet evolving mission requirements. Savings are realized through no up-front costs and a “pay as you go” acquisition model, reducing waste usually associated with overbuying of IT equipment to eventually meet an expectation of mission requirement. Under this contract, ViON is responsible for providing on-demand, on-premise computing, networking and storage solutions for a variety of systems and applications for the command’s research, development, testing and evaluation core infrastructures, laboratory and data center environments. This contract includes options, which if exercised, would bring the maximum contract value to $49,990,000. The Space and Naval Warfare Systems Command, San Diego, is the contracting activity (N00039-17-D-0003). body_en: Autoflight V5000 Matrix william.moore@… Tue, 03/31/2026 - 07:48 The V5000 Matrix is a lift-plus-cruise hybrid-electric/all-electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft being developed by AutoFlight Europe GmbH. Unveiled in February 2026, the aircraft performed a remotely piloted transition from thrustborne hover to wingborne cruise, demonstrating that flight testing is already underway. Industry commentators have suggested that entry into service could be as soon as 2027/2028, although there is no confirmation of this. Certification is to be sought from the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) under powered-lift regulations. Structure and Powertrain The Matrix pushes regulations to their maximum, being a 10 seat eVTOL with a maximum take-off weight of 5,700kg (hybrid version). The aircraft could be configured in a 6-seat VIP layout, or a 9-seat business layout plus a pilot. It will also feature a lavatory, the first eVTOL design to incorporate this, an indication of its lengthier flight duration capabilities. An uncrewed cargo variant is also in development. The intended market is more regional-focused than previous eVTOL designs. Structurally, the V5000 is an evolution of the previous Autoflight Prosperity I and CarryAll cargo variant. It features a long, aerodynamic cabin with panoramic viewing windows and skid-style landing gear. A main high wing is complemented by two smaller wings to the front and rear of the aircraft, with three booms extending across all three wings parallel to the cabin, on each side. 20 two-blade fixed propellers are mounted to the six booms to provide lift, while eight cruise propellers provide forward thrust, four mounted to the front and four to the rear. body_en: Turkey Signs $11 Billion Eurofighter Deal hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:19 Turkey has signed a long-anticipated £8 billion ($11 billion) deal to acquire Eurofighter Typhoons, the first major export contract for the four-nation combat aircraft since 2017. Twenty new-built aircraft will be purchased in the country’s first acquisition of a European combat aircraft after decades of operating new and secondhand U.S.-built fighters. But Turkey’s Eurofighter order could more than double in size, according to Turkish Defense Minister Yasar Guler. He declared that Ankara would also buy another 24 aircraft second hand, 12 each from Oman and Qatar. If those sales go through, Oman would be giving up Eurofighter operations. With deliveries of the new-build aircraft not due until 2030, delivering those second-hand aircraft—potentially as early as next year from Qatar, according to Guler—would allow Turkey to accelerate the Eurofighter’s entry into service and enable the retirement of older aircraft from its inventory, including the McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom. BAE Systems, which will produce the newly built aircraft in Warton, England, says it will receive £5.4 billion of the £8 billion deal. Included in the £5.4 billion are the aircraft and the weapons package from MBDA, including some integration work, potentially for Turkish indigenous weaponry. The remaining £2.6 billion is support and training activity, which will be contracted later, BAE Systems officials say. It is unclear whether the deal will ultimately include offsets to enable Turkish industry to become involved in the Eurofighter program and for Turkey to have a level of freedom of action for the fleet. After decades of facing numerous arms embargoes, Turkey often demands the ability to locally perform airframe, system and engine maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) in-country. The deal was struck during a meeting between UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan in Ankara. Starmer said the deal was a win for British workers and the wider UK defense industry. Government officials claim the order is “saving the Warton production line,” after concerns about a lack of new orders for UK-built Typhoons were expressed by workers unions. UK industry has a 37% share in the Eurofighter program and production of major component assemblies is being ramped up thanks to orders from the other Eurofighter partner nations including Germany, Italy and Spain. “Today’s announcement extends Typhoon production and preserves crucial sovereign skills which underpin the UK’s defense and security,” BAE Systems CEO Charles Woodburn said. The deal is another major boost for the UK defense industry, coming just weeks after the UK’s Type 26 frigates were selected by Norway in a £10 billion deal. UK Defense Secretary John Healey said the deal went beyond the procurement of aircraft. “It is the leading edge of the growing defense and industrial partnership between our two nations,” he said. As part of the visit, Starmer also visited the facilities of Turkish Aerospace Industries, where he was shown the indigenous Kaan combat aircraft. He was also exposed to the Hurjet advanced jet trainer, a potential candidate to replace the BAE Systems Hawk jet trainer in the UK Royal Air Force (RAF) inventory. The deal follows three years of negotiations, which have included lobbying of the German government for Berlin to lift a restriction on a Eurofighter sale after Erdoğan’s government arrested Istanbul Mayor Ekrem İmamoğlu, who is seen as a serious presidential rival to Erdoğan in upcoming elections. The administration of German Chancellor Friedrich Merz lifted the sanctions in part because of the benefit to German industry. A memorandum of understanding between the UK and Turkish governments for a Eurofighter sale was agreed to in July. Turkey’s interest in the aircraft is driven in part by a need for a more capable air combat platform to be available in the interim until advanced versions of the Kaan aircraft are produced in the 2030s. Ankara’s decision to opt for a European fighter, meanwhile, will have been driven by a need to diversify sources of supply after facing sanctions from the U.S. over its purchase of a Russian air defense system and banishment from the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter program. The transfer of Omani and Qatari aircraft to Turkey begs questions over the future of additional Eurofighter orders from Qatar, which has long been linked to orders for a further 12 aircraft for a total of 36. Oman, meanwhile, appears to want to consolidate its fighter fleet around the Lockheed Martin F-16 Block 50. In BAE Systems’ 2023 full-year results, the company revealed that the Omani air force had chosen not to renew support arrangements for its Typhoons, and it is unclear how active that fleet now is. Buying these additional aircraft would mean Turkey would have a mix of three configurations in its fleet. Qatar’s aircraft have the Mk.0 version of the active electronically scanned array European Common Radar System (ECRS) radar, while Oman’s feature the mechanically scanned Captor sensor. In addition to the Eurofighter order, Erdoğan and Starmer also revealed they were working on a new trade and security pact. (MRO)。该协议是在英国首相基尔·斯塔默和土耳其总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安在安卡拉会晤期间达成的。斯塔默表示，这笔交易对英国工人和更广泛的英国国防工业来说是一场胜利。在工会表达了对英国制造的台风战机缺乏新订单的担忧后，政府官员声称该订单正在“拯救沃顿生产线”。英国工业在欧洲战斗机项目中占有 37% 的份额，并且由于德国、意大利和西班牙等其他欧洲战斗机伙伴国家的订单，主要零部件组件的生产正在增加。 BAE Systems 首席执行官查尔斯·伍德伯恩 (Charles Woodburn) 表示：“今天的公告延长了台风战机的生产，并保留了支撑英国国防和安全的关键主权技能。”这笔交易是英国国防工业的又一重大推动力，就在几周前，挪威在一笔价值 100 亿英镑的交易中选择了英国 26 型护卫舰。英国国防部长约翰·希利表示，该交易超出了飞机采购范围。 “这是我们两国之间不断发展的国防和工业伙伴关系的前沿，”他说。作为访问的一部分，斯塔默还参观了土耳其航空航天工业公司的设施，在那里他参观了本土的卡恩战斗机。他还接触了 Hurjet 高级喷气教练机，该教练机是英国皇家空军 (RAF) 库存中 BAE Systems Hawk 喷气教练机的潜在替代者。该协议经过了三年的谈判，其中包括在埃尔多安政府逮捕了伊斯坦布尔市长埃克雷姆·伊马莫格鲁后，游说德国政府要求柏林解除对欧洲战斗机销售的限制，后者被视为埃尔多安在即将举行的选举中的严重总统竞争对手。德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨(Friedrich Merz)政府取消了制裁，部分原因是这对德国工业有利。英国和土耳其政府于 7 月就欧洲战斗机销售达成了一份谅解备忘录。土耳其对这款飞机的兴趣部分是因为在 2030 年代生产出先进版本的卡恩飞机之前，需要在过渡期间提供更强大的空战平台。与此同时，安卡拉决定选择欧洲战斗机，是因为在因购买俄罗斯防空系统而面临美国制裁以及被排除在 F-35 联合攻击战斗机计划之外后，供应来源多样化的需要。阿曼和卡塔尔飞机向土耳其的转移引发了人们对卡塔尔额外欧洲战斗机订单未来的疑问，长期以来，卡塔尔的欧洲战斗机订单一直与另外 12 架飞机的订单有关，总计 36 架。与此同时，阿曼似乎希望以洛克希德·马丁公司的 F-16 Block 50 为中心巩固其战斗机机队。在 BAE Systems 的 2023 年全年业绩中，该公司透露，阿曼空军已选择不为其续签支持安排。台风，目前尚不清楚该舰队现在的活跃程度。购买这些额外的飞机意味着土耳其的机队将混合三种配置。卡塔尔的飞机配备了 Mk.0 版本的有源电子扫描阵列欧洲通用雷达系统 (ECRS) 雷达，而阿曼的飞机配备了机械扫描 Captor 传感器。除了欧洲战斗机订单外，埃尔多安和斯塔默还透露，他们正在制定一项新的贸易和安全协议。发行《航空航天日报与国防报告》，2025 年 10 月 28 日 文章类型 文章 主要类别 飞机与推进系统 作者托尼·奥斯本 内容来源 航空航天日报与国防报告 从列表中排除？没有标签： 土耳其 、 欧洲战斗机台风 、 BAE 系统 、 MBDA 门控 ASD 特色图片 Typhoon_1600px.jpg title_zh: 诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司的秘密自主飞机“莲花计划”揭晓
summary: Project Lotus, Northrop Grumman’s Secret Autonomous Aircraft Revealed hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:05 Northrop Grumman has secretly built a large new uncrewed aircraft system (UAS), dubbed Project Lotus, at the company’s Scaled Composites rapid prototy
summary_zh: 莲花计划，诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司的秘密自主飞机揭晓 hockensmithawi…
body_en: Project Lotus, Northrop Grumman’s Secret Autonomous Aircraft Revealed hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:05 Northrop Grumman has secretly built a large new uncrewed aircraft system (UAS), dubbed Project Lotus, at the company’s Scaled Composites rapid prototyping facility in Mojave, California, a source familiar with the project tells Aviation Week. A photo of the aircraft reviewed by Aviation Week revealed a completed, turbofan-powered aircraft parked within the Scaled Composites compound at the public airport. The Lotus UAS design in some ways resembles features of the newly revealed Lockheed Martin Project Vectis, with a long, slender fuselage positioned forward of the leading edges of the wings, capped by a nose with swept-back edges leading to a slender point. In many other respects, the Lotus and Vectis designs diverge. Unlike the engine inlet mounted low at mid-fuselage for the Vectis aircraft, the Lotus inlet sits high atop of the extreme aft section of its fuselage. The Lotus also sports sharply canted tails, breaking from the tailless-configured Vectis. Project Lotus appears to represent Northrop’s candidate for the U.S. Air Force’s Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) Increment 2 program, which is finalizing requirements for competitive prototypes ahead of a scheduled acquisition process next year. The photo reveals that Northrop has already built a demonstrator, perhaps gaining a step on Lockheed’s rival design, which is not scheduled to reach first flight until 2027. As Northrop’s rapid prototyping arm, the Scaled Composites facility frequently builds aircraft demonstrators in secret. Scaled Composites registered a turbofan-powered, fixed-wing aircraft identified only as Model 444 earlier this year with the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), which granted the organization the N444LX tail number. It is not clear if the registration represents Project Lotus or another undisclosed project. Northrop also is building the XRQ-73, also known as the Series Hybrid Electric Propulsion AiR Demonstration (Shepard), for DARPA. In response to questions about Project Lotus from Aviation Week, Northrop avoided direct answers, but spoke generally about its internal investments in autonomous aircraft. “Our investments prioritize production at speed and scale, without sacrificing performance or capability. The Northrop Grumman team has generated step-change advancements in production speed, weight and parts reduction, and overall cost efficiency. These advancements benefit the spectrum of autonomous capabilities we produce at Northrop Grumman for U.S. and international customers,” Northrop said. As Lockheed’s Project Vectis design revealed in September, Northrop’s Project Lotus represents one side in a long-running debate within industry and the Air Force over the future direction of the CCA fleet between concepts that emphasize greater survivability or lower cost. In 2024, the Air Force decided to seek a middle ground between cost and survivability with the selected competitive prototypes for the CCA Increment 1 program. The General Atomics Aeronautical Systems Inc. YFQ-42 and Anduril YFQ-44 are large aircraft that feature some low-observable, or stealth, technology. But the aircraft are larger and costlier than, for example, the Kratos XQ-58, and lack the stealthier features of Project Vectis and Project Lotus. In September, Air Force officials said they were considering the full spectrum of options for the Increment 2 CCA requirement, ranging from exquisite survivability to small, air-launched systems. Project Lotus also lends new insight into how Northrop’s internal CCA concepts have evolved from previous, publicly released ideas. As the Air Force competition for CCAs heated up in 2023, Northrop showed off the SG-1 and SG-2 concepts, which appeared similar to the cranked-kite planform of the U.S. Navy-funded X-47B demonstrator. Around the same time, Northrop also unveiled the Model 437 concept, an autonomous spinoff from the crewed Model 401 Sierra demonstrator. The Model 437 finally emerged as a piloted demonstrator aircraft in 2024. Earlier this year, Northrop announced that the aircraft had transitioned into the Beacon demonstrator, serving as a testbed for mission autonomy technology. body_zh: 诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司的莲花项目秘密揭晓 hockensmithawi…2025 年 10 月 27 日星期一 - 18:05 一位熟悉该项目的消息人士告诉《航空周刊》，诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司已在该公司位于加利福尼亚州莫哈韦的规模化复合材料快速原型制造工厂秘密建造了一个大型新型无人驾驶飞机系统 (UAS)，称为“莲花项目”。 《航空周刊》查看的一张飞机照片显示，一架完工的涡轮风扇飞机停在公共机场的 Scaled Composites 园区内。莲花无人机的设计在某些方面类似于新推出的洛克希德·马丁公司 Vectis 项目的特征，其长而细长的机身位于机翼前缘的前面，其机头顶部有后掠边缘，通向细长的尖端。 Lotus 和 Vectis 的设计在许多其他方面存在差异。与 Vectis 飞机的发动机进气口安装在机身中部较低的位置不同，Lotus 进气口位于机身最后部的高处。 Lotus 还拥有急剧倾斜的尾部，与无尾配置的 Vectis 不同。 Lotus 项目似乎代表了诺斯罗普美国空军协同作战飞机 (CCA) Increment 2 计划的候选者，该计划将在明年预定的采购过程之前最终确定竞争性原型机的要求。这张照片显示，诺斯罗普公司已经制造了一架验证机，或许比洛克希德公司的竞争对手设计领先一步，后者预计要到 2027 年才能实现首飞。作为诺斯罗普公司的快速原型制造部门，Scaled Composites 工厂经常秘密制造飞机验证机。今年早些时候，Scaled Composites 向美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 注册了一架涡轮风扇动力固定翼飞机，型号为 444，并授予该组织 N444LX 尾号。目前尚不清楚该注册是否代表 Project Lotus 还是另一个未公开的项目。诺斯罗普还正在为 DARPA 建造 XRQ-73，也称为系列混合电动推进 AiR 演示（Shepard）。在回答《航空周刊》有关莲花项目的问题时，诺斯罗普避免直接回答，但笼统地谈到了其对自动驾驶飞机的内部投资。诺斯罗普表示：“我们的投资优先考虑速度和规模生产，而不牺牲性能或能力。诺斯罗普·格鲁曼团队在生产速度、重量和零件减少以及整体成本效率方面取得了巨大进步。这些进步有利于我们在诺斯罗普·格鲁曼为美国和国际客户生产的一系列自主能力。”正如洛克希德公司的 Vectis 项目设计在 9 月透露的那样，诺斯罗普的 Lotus 项目代表了工业界和空军内部关于 CCA 机队未来方向的长期争论中的一方，争论强调更高的生存能力或更低的成本。 2024 年，空军决定为 CCA Increment 1 计划选定具有竞争力的原型机，在成本和生存能力之间寻求中间立场。通用原子航空系统公司的 YFQ-42 和 Anduril YFQ-44 是大型飞机，采用一些低可观测或隐形技术。但该飞机比 Kratos XQ-58 等飞机更大、更昂贵，并且缺乏 Project Vectis 和 Project Lotus 的隐身功能。 9 月，空军官员表示，他们正在考虑满足 Increment 2 CCA 要求的全方位选择，从出色的生存能力到小型空射系统。 Lotus 项目还为诺斯罗普内部 CCA 概念如何从之前公开发布的想法演变而来提供了新的见解。随着 2023 年空军 CCA 竞争的白热化，诺斯罗普展示了 SG-1 和 SG-2 概念，它们看起来类似于美国海军资助的 X-47B 验证机的曲柄风筝平面图。大约在同一时间，诺斯罗普还推出了 Model 437 概念车，这是载人 Model 401 Sierra 验证机的自主衍生产品。 437 型最终于 2024 年成为有人驾驶验证机。今年早些时候，诺斯罗普宣布该飞机已转变为 Beacon 验证机，作为任务自主技术的测试平台。发行《航空航天日报与国防报告》，2025 年 10 月 28 日 《航空周刊与航天技术》，2025 年 11 月 10 日 文章类型 文章主要类别 飞机与推进系统 作者 Steve Trimble 内容来源 航空航天日报与国防报告 航空周刊与航天技术 从列表中排除？没有标签：UAS、洛克希德·马丁公司、诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司、协同作战飞机 (CCA) 门控 AWST-MRO ASD 特色图片 snapshot_2025-10-27_scaled_composites_from_gmaps.png 二级类别/子类别 航空航天防御飞机与推进系统 标题中是否有 iframe？关闭 知识中心特色内容 关闭 不呈现广告 关闭 暂时设置为 AWIN 免费增值 关闭

body_en: Second B-21 Enters Flight Test In Palmdale hockensmithawi… Thu, 09/11/2025 - 18:36 The B-21 Raider program completed the first flight of a second airborne test aircraft in Palmdale, California on Sept. 11, clearing a key milestone a month before the 10th anniversary of the U.S. Air Force contract award to Northrop Grumman. Witnesses posted video on social media showing the B-21 flight-test aircraft passing overhead with wheels retracted and followed by a Lockheed Martin F-16 chase plane. “We can now expedite critical evaluations of mission systems and weapons capabilities, directly supporting the strategic deterrence and combat effectiveness envisioned for this aircraft,” Air Force Secretary Troy Meink said. Northrop assembles all B-21s inside Building 401 on Site 4 of the Air Force’s Plant 42 complex at Palmdale Regional Airport. New test aircraft must fly out of the public airport after they have been assembled, before they can relocate to the secure area of nearby Edwards Air Force Base. The milestone comes nearly 22 months after Northrop completed the maiden sortie of the first flight test version of the B-21 on Nov. 10, 2023. The company has also delivered to the Air Force two more fully assembled airframes, which are reserved for static and fatigue testing on the ground. Two more flight-test aircraft have been in some stage of assembly since at least February 2022. Air Force officials say the program remains on track to clear the initial operational capability milestone in the mid-2020s. Northrop won the $21.4 billion contract in October 2015 for the engineering and manufacturing development phase of the Long-Range Strike Bomber, which the Air Force later rechristened as the B-21 Raider. The Air Force also signed orders with Northrop for the first two-year lots of low-rate initial production. body_en: EHang VT35 william.moore@… Tue, 07/29/2025 - 08:58 The VT35 is an autonomous lift-plus-cruise eVTOL being developed by EHang. The first prototype VT35 has completed final assembly and is now undergoing flight testing, with the first public flight occurring in December 2025. Certification will be with the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC), as with EHang’s EH216-S, and certification is expected to be accelerated owing to the company’s experience certifying the previous model. Structure and Powertrain The VT35 seats two passengers inside a cabin featuring panoramic viewing windows. It features eight distributed lift propellers on tandem wings for vertical takeoff and landing—four facing upward and four downward—and an aft-mounted pusher prop for cruise flight. Each fan is individually powered by it’s own electric motor. Distributed electric propulsion (DEP) is the name given to this method of powering aircraft. title_en: Delta Emails Diamond Medallion, Forgets To Delete AI Prompt About Being Warm & Empathetic
title_zh: 达美航空向钻石奖章邮件发送电子邮件，忘记删除有关热情和同理心的人工智能提示
summary: A Delta Diamond Medallion complained about chat support and got a reply that still began with an AI prompt asking for a "warm, empathetic tone." Oops.
summary_zh: 达美航空钻石奖章会员抱怨聊天支持，但得到的回复仍然以人工智能提示开头，要求使用“温暖、善解人意的语气”。哎呀。
body_en: I guess it shouldn’t be surprising that this happens every so often, but it sure is kind of hilarious when it does.
A Diamond Medallion’s shocking email response from Delta

JonNYC flags how a Delta Diamond Medallion member emailed the carrier feedback about a negative experience. The response from Delta started with “here’s a more polished and professional version with a warm, empathetic tone.”

Funny enough, the feedback being provided by the customer was specifically regarding frustration in dealing with Delta representatives through the chat feature. This Delta representative assured this person that the complaints were being taken seriously… only to not take out the line about AI.
For those curious, the email response continued as follows
Thank you for reaching out to Delta Air Lines regarding your experience. I sincerely appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback with us.

I am truly sorry for the frustration and inconvenience you experienced during your interactions with our representatives. Receiving inconsistent information and having a chat session end unexpectedly can be incredibly disappointing, especially when you are seeking assistance. As a valued Diamond Medallion Member, you deserve knowledgeable, attentive, and seamless service, and I regret that we did not meet those expectations.

Please be assured that we take your concerns very seriously. I have shared your feedback with our Flight Operations Senior Leadership team for review, and we will work closely with the appropriate departments to address the service shortcomings you described. Feedback such as yours is invaluable as we continue to improve our processes and enhance the customer experience.
Delta just responded to my case with "Here's a more polished and professional version with a warm, empathetic tone:"
In Delta’s defense, the issue here was being caught
Look, I’m trying to give a certain someone the morning off here, so let me say this… 😉

For at least a couple of decades now, airlines have largely automated their customer relations responses, at least in some major way. Of course this back-and-forth chatting with an AI tool to come up with a response is a fairly new concept, but even before that, customer relations would basically be copying and pasting different form responses, with only slight customization.
We’ve also seen customer relations emails over the years where the representatives forgot to fill in the details, and that shows, like the email saying “Dear [insert name].”

I don’t think anyone actually expects that an airline customer relations employee sits down and writes each response from scratch. What actually matters is that the feedback is passed on to the relevant departments, and I assume (hope?) that’s still happening.

So what matters here is that “senior leadership” knows that a Diamond Medallion isn’t happy with something that happened, and that can help inform future decisions (assuming there are enough complaints). Of course the “crime” here is forgetting to remove the evidence of the AI… oops!

I guess a human going back-and-forth with some sort of an AI tool is still better than what I covered back in 2023, where American basically automated its customer relations , where any response from “Gemma Flint” was automated, rather than being a human response. I’m sure that’s still going on, but I believe they cycle through names…

A top-tier Diamond Medallion member emailed Delta to provide feedback about the company’s chat feature, only to then receive a response from customer relations that started with “here’s a more polished and professional version with a warm, empathetic tone.”

As you’d expect, this response shocked the customer. In fairness, I don’t think anyone actually thought Delta wasn’t using AI for customer relations emails. The issue here is forgetting to remove the prompt. So perhaps Delta needs to add a new prompt to its AI script, specifically checking for no obvious references to AI. 😉
What do you make of this Delta customer relations response?
body_zh: 我想这种情况经常发生并不奇怪，但当它发生时确实有点搞笑。
达美航空钻石奖章令人震惊的电子邮件回复
JonNYC 标记了达美钻石尊爵会会员如何通过电子邮件向承运商发送有关负面体验的反馈。达美航空的回应首先是“这是一个更精致、更专业的版本，语气温暖、富有同情心。”
有趣的是，客户提供的反馈特别涉及通过聊天功能与达美航空代表打交道时的挫败感。这位达美航空代表向此人保证，我们正在认真对待这些投诉……只是为了不删除有关人工智能的言论。
对于那些好奇的人，电子邮件回复如下
感谢您就您的体验联系达美航空。我衷心感谢您抽出时间与我们分享您的反馈。
对于您在与我们代表的互动过程中所经历的沮丧和不便，我深表歉意。收到不一致的信息以及聊天会话意外结束可能会令人非常失望，尤其是当您寻求帮助时。作为尊贵的尊爵会钻石籍会员，您应该得到知识丰富、周到且无缝的服务，很遗憾我们没有满足这些期望。
请放心，我们非常重视您的疑虑。我已与我们的航班运营高级领导团队分享您的反馈意见，以供审核，我们将与相应部门密切合作，解决您所描述的服务缺陷。在我们不断改进流程和增强客户体验的过程中，您的反馈非常宝贵。
达美航空刚刚对我的案例做出了回应，“这是一个更精致、更专业的版本，语气温暖、富有同情心：”
达美航空辩称，这里的问题已被抓住
听着，我想给某人一个早上的休息时间，所以让我这么说……😉
至少几十年来，航空公司已经在很大程度上实现了客户关系响应的自动化，至少在某些主要方面是这样。当然，这种与人工智能工具来回聊天以得出响应是一个相当新的概念，但即使在此之前，客户关系基本上也会复制和粘贴不同的表单响应，只有轻微的定制。
多年来，我们还看到过客户关系电子邮件，其中代表忘记填写详细信息，这表明，就像电子邮件中写着“亲爱的[插入姓名]”。
我认为没有人真正期望航空公司客户关系员工坐下来从头开始写下每条回复。真正重要的是反馈被传递给相关部门，我认为（希望？）这种情况仍在发生。
因此，这里重要的是“高级领导层”知道钻石奖章对所发生的事情不满意，这可以帮助为未来的决策提供信息（假设有足够多的投诉）。当然，这里的“罪行”是忘记删除人工智能的证据……哎呀！
我想人类使用某种人工智能工具来回移动仍然比我在 2023 年报道的要好，当时美国航空基本上实现了客户关系的自动化，“Gemma Flint”的任何响应都是自动化的，而不是人类的响应。我确信这种情况仍在继续，但我相信他们会循环使用名称......
一位顶级尊爵会钻石会员通过电子邮件向达美航空发送了有关该公司聊天功能的反馈，结果却收到了客户关系部的回复，开头是“这是一个更精致、更专业的版本，语气温暖、富有同理心。”
正如您所料，这个回应让客户感到震惊。公平地说，我认为没有人真正认为达美航空没有在客户关系电子邮件中使用人工智能。这里的问题是忘记删除提示。因此，也许 Delta 需要在其 AI 脚本中添加一个新的提示，专门检查是否没有明显的 AI 引用。 😉

title_en: Shark Tank’s Robert Herjavec named in ONEflight jet-card lawsuit
title_zh: Shark Tank 的 Robert Herjavec 因 ONEflight 喷气卡诉讼而被点名
summary: Shark Tank investor Robert Herjavec has been named in a lawsuit by a ONEflight customer who says the… The post Shark Tank’s Robert Herjavec named in ONEflight jet-card lawsuit appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 创智赢家 (Shark Tank) 投资者罗伯特·赫贾维克 (Robert Herjavec) 在 ONEflight 客户提起的诉讼中被点名，该客户表示……
body_en: Shark Tank investor Robert Herjavec has been named in a lawsuit by a ONEflight customer who says the television personality’s endorsements helped persuade him to entrust more than $741,000 to the now-defunct private jet charter broker.
Herjavec denies having an ownership stake or knowing about the company’s financial problems. He told Private Jet Card Comparisons that he was also preparing to sue ONEflight.
“Like many people, including employees, I was completely fooled and deceived by this company and its founder,” Herjavec told the publication.

Customer Mark Heimbouch filed the lawsuit in the US District Court for the District of Colorado on October 22, 2026. It names ONEflight entities, CEO Ferren Rajput, sales executives Mark Dismuke and Mark Sanchez, and Herjavec as defendants.

Heimbouch alleges that he wired another $95,000 to ONEflight on September 15, one day before the company suspended flight services. According to the complaint, sales staff had assured him the business was financially healthy and pressed him to deposit more money to secure future flight rates.
The payment brought his claimed unreturned balance to $741,456.23. Heimbouch says his subsequent demands for a refund were unsuccessful.

ONEflight, based in Englewood, Colorado, sold prepaid jet cards and arranges flights through third-party aircraft operators. Customers deposited money for future travel, with the broker paying operators to conduct the flights.

ONEflight announced its suspension on September 16 , saying it would pause flight activity for 30 days or until further notice while reviewing its operations. Rajput had told Private Jet Card Comparisons that customer funds were not held in escrow.
The company’s website has since gone offline.

The lawsuit alleges that Herjavec’s reputation as a successful investor gave Heimbouch confidence in ONEflight’s financial stability. It describes Herjavec as an equity partner as well as a brand ambassador, an assertion he denied in his response.
The claims against Herjavec include fraud, deceptive trade practices, civil conspiracy and unjust enrichment.
Herjavec has appeared in ONEflight’s advertising campaigns since 2019.

The company’s suspension followed other signs of financial pressure. In August 2026, ONEflight announced a 35% surcharge for customers with contracted flight rates, then withdrew it hours later after customer objections. Some charter operators had also reported overdue payments, while others said they had been paid.
Heimbouch is seeking repayment, statutory damages of approximately $2.22 million, punitive damages and legal fees. He has requested a jury trial.
The post Shark Tank’s Robert Herjavec named in ONEflight jet-card lawsuit appeared first on AeroTime .
body_zh: 一位 ONEflight 客户在诉讼中提到了创智赢家 (Shark Tank) 投资者罗伯特·赫贾维克 (Robert Herjavec) 的名字，该客户表示，这位电视名人的认可帮助说服他将超过 741,000 美元委托给这家现已解散的私人飞机包机经纪人。
赫贾维克否认拥有该公司的所有权股份或了解该公司的财务问题。他告诉 Private Jet Card Comparisons，他还准备起诉 ONEflight。
赫贾维克告诉该刊物：“像许多人，包括员工一样，我完全被这家公司及其创始人愚弄和欺骗了。”
客户 Mark Heimbouch 于 2026 年 10 月 22 日向美国科罗拉多州地方法院提起诉讼。诉讼将 ONEflight 实体、首席执行官 Ferren Rajput、销售主管 Mark Dismuke 和 Mark Sanchez 以及 Herjavec 列为被告。
Heimbouch 声称，他于 9 月 15 日（即该公司暂停航班服务的前一天）又向 ONEflight 汇了 95,000 美元。根据投诉，销售人员向他保证公司的财务状况良好，并敦促他存入更多资金以确保未来的航班价格。
这笔付款使他声称的未退还余额达到 741,456.23 美元。海姆布赫表示，他随后提出的退款要求没有成功。
ONEflight 总部位于科罗拉多州恩格尔伍德，出售预付费喷气卡并通过第三方飞机运营商安排航班。客户为未来的旅行存钱，经纪人向运营商支付航班费用。
ONEflight于9月16日宣布停飞，称将暂停航班活动30天或直至另行通知，同时审查其运营情况。拉杰普特告诉 Private Jet Card Comparisons，客户资金没有托管。
该公司的网站现已下线。
该诉讼称，Herjavec 作为成功投资者的声誉使 Heimbouch 对 ONEflight 的财务稳定性充满信心。它将 Herjavec 描述为股权合伙人以及品牌大使，但他在回应中否认了这一说法。
针对 Herjavec 的指控包括欺诈、欺骗性贸易行为、民事阴谋和不当得利。
自 2019 年以来，Herjavec 一直出现在 ONEflight 的广告活动中。
该公司因出现其他财务压力迹象而停牌。 2026 年 8 月，ONEflight 宣布对签订合同航班价格的客户收取 35% 的附加费，但在客户反对后数小时后撤回。一些包机运营商还报告了逾期付款，而另一些则表示已收到付款。
Heimbouch 正在寻求赔偿、约 222 万美元的法定损害赔偿、惩罚性赔偿和法律费用。他已请求陪审团审判。

summary: The US Defense Intelligence Agency has published a rare photograph of China’s secretive reusable spaceplane in orbit, showing… The post US intelligence releases rare image of China’s secretive spaceplane appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 美国国防情报局公布了一张中国秘密可重复使用航天飞机在轨运行的罕见照片，显示……
body_en: The US Defense Intelligence Agency has published a rare photograph of China’s secretive reusable spaceplane in orbit, showing its open payload bay and another spacecraft attached at the rear.

The image appears in the agency’s latest “Challenges to Security in Space” report, released on October 26, 2026, offering a clearer view of a vehicle whose appearance and missions China has largely kept out of public view.
Satellite imagery company Vantor, formerly Maxar, told media outlets that its WorldView-3 satellite took the photograph on May 28, 2024, from just under 90 kilometers away.

The Chinese vehicle resembles a small space shuttle, with wings, twin tail fins and a central cargo compartment. Its overall layout is similar to the Boeing-built X-37B operated by the US Space Force.
A lower-resolution version appeared in a US Space Force presentation in South Korea in 2024. The new report identifies the vehicle as a Chinese spaceplane and provides a more detailed image.

China began orbital tests of a reusable experimental spacecraft in September 2020 with a two-day flight. A second mission lasted 276 days, while a third ended in September 2024 after 268 days in orbit.

Its fourth launch took place on February 7, 2026, aboard a Long March-2F rocket from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center. Chinese state news agency Xinhua said that mission would test reusable spacecraft technology for peaceful uses, but disclosed few details, Reuters reported .

Often referred to as Shenlong, the Chinese spacecraft launches aboard a rocket and returns to a runway. That allows equipment carried into orbit to be brought back to Earth rather than left in space or destroyed during reentry. Its precise payloads and mission objectives remain largely undisclosed.

The US has used the X-37B to test equipment and techniques during extended orbital flights. For its eighth mission, the Space Force announced experiments involving laser communications between satellites and a quantum inertial sensor designed to help spacecraft navigate without GPS.

Earlier X-37B missions tested changing orbit through aerobraking, exposed seeds to space radiation and carried an experiment investigating technology for collecting solar energy and transmitting power to Earth.

body_zh: 美国国防情报局发布了一张中国在轨秘密可重复使用航天飞机的罕见照片，显示其开放的有效载荷舱和后部安装的另一艘航天器。
该图像出现在该机构于 2026 年 10 月 26 日发布的最新《太空安全挑战》报告中，为中国在很大程度上将其外观和任务排除在公众视野之外的飞行器提供了更清晰的视角。
卫星图像公司 Vantor（前身为 Maxar）告诉媒体，其 WorldView-3 卫星于 2024 年 5 月 28 日在距离不到 90 公里的地方拍摄了这张照片。
中国的飞行器类似于小型航天飞机，有机翼、双尾翼和一个中央货舱。其整体布局与美国太空军运营的波音制造的X-37B类似。
2024 年，美国太空军在韩国举行的演示中出现了较低分辨率的版本。新报告将这架飞行器识别为中国航天飞机，并提供了更详细的图像。
中国于 2020 年 9 月开始对可重复使用实验航天器进行轨道测试，并进行了为期两天的飞行。第二次任务持续了 276 天，第三次任务在轨道运行 268 天后于 2024 年 9 月结束。
它的第四次发射于2026年2月7日在酒泉卫星发射中心搭载长征二号F火箭进行。据路透社报道，中国官方通讯社新华社表示，这次任务将测试用于和平用途的可重复使用航天器技术，但透露的细节很少。
这艘中国航天器通常被称为“神龙”，搭载火箭发射并返回跑道。这使得进入轨道的设备可以被带回地球，而不是留在太空中或在重返大气层期间被毁坏。其精确的有效载荷和任务目标在很大程度上仍未公开。
美国已使用 X-37B 在延长轨道飞行期间测试设备和技术。在其第八次任务中，太空部队宣布了涉及卫星和量子惯性传感器之间激光通信的实验，该传感器旨在帮助航天器在没有 GPS 的情况下导航。
早期的 X-37B 任务测试了通过空气制动改变轨道、将种子暴露在太空辐射中，并进行了一项研究收集太阳能和向地球传输电力的技术的实验。

title_en: Boeing sees demand for nearly 3,000 freighters as cargo traffic doubles by 2045
title_zh: 波音预计到 2045 年货运量将翻倍，对近 3,000 架货机的需求
summary: Air cargo traffic is expected to double by 2045, creating demand for nearly 3,000 new and converted freighters… The post Boeing sees demand for nearly 3,000 freighters as cargo traffic doubles by 2045 appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 到 2045 年，航空货运量预计将翻一番，创造近 3,000 架新货机和改装货机的需求……波音公司预计近 3,000 架货机的需求
body_en: Air cargo traffic is expected to double by 2045, creating demand for nearly 3,000 new and converted freighters as operators expand their fleets and replace older aircraft, according to Boeing’s latest forecast.

Boeing released its 2026 World Air Cargo Forecast on October 28, 2026, at The International Air Cargo Association’s Air Cargo Forum in Miami. The manufacturer expects the global freighter fleet to grow from 2,395 aircraft in 2025 to 4,010 by 2045, an increase of 67%.

Boeing forecasts demand for 2,930 freighter deliveries over those two decades. About 55% would support growth, while the remaining 45% would replace retiring aircraft, the company said. Converted passenger jets are expected to account for roughly two-thirds of deliveries, with newly built freighters making up the rest.

The market currently includes converted narrowbody aircraft such as the Boeing 737-800 and Airbus A321, along with larger Boeing 767 and Airbus A330 conversions. New-build options include the Boeing 777F and the upcoming Boeing 777-8F and Airbus A350F.

The forecast points to growth in online shopping, shifting manufacturing locations and shipments of high-value technology, including artificial intelligence hardware, as sources of demand in the next two decades.

Boeing cited IATA data showing that more than 70% of AI-related goods were transported by air in 2025. Such shipments add to a market that has traditionally relied on moving perishable products, expensive equipment and other goods that need to reach customers quickly.

Global air cargo traffic reached a record high in 2025, growing nearly 5% from the previous year despite trade disputes and geopolitical disruption, Boeing said. Over the next two decades, the manufacturer expects traffic to increase by an average of 3.5% annually.

“Air cargo’s adaptability and speed are strategic advantages enabling reliable transport, dynamic rerouting and critical support for evolving supply chains,” said Darren Hulst, Boeing Vice President of Commercial Marketing.
“As global trade patterns change and demand for time-sensitive, high-value goods grows,” he added, “dedicated freighters will remain essential to global commerce.”

Routes serving Asia are expected to lead growth and account for approximately 60% of the global air cargo market. Boeing said carriers are adjusting their networks as production moves between countries and disruptions force shipments onto different routes.

Dedicated freighters are expected to continue carrying more than half of global air cargo traffic. Historically, they have transported approximately 55%, measured in cargo tonne-kilometers, with passenger aircraft carrying the remainder in their belly holds.

Express operators are also expected to gain a larger share of the business. Boeing forecasts that companies offering time-definite and express deliveries will carry nearly 25% of global air cargo traffic by 2045.
The forecast follows Airbus’s latest cargo outlook , released earlier in October 2026, which identified North America as the largest source of freighter aircraft demand over the next 20 years.
Boeing estimates that goods shipped by air represent less than 1% of global trade by volume but roughly one-third of its value.

body_zh: 根据波音公司的最新预测，到 2045 年，航空货运量预计将翻一番，随着运营商扩大机队和更换旧飞机，将创造近 3,000 架新货机和改装货机的需求。
波音公司于 2026 年 10 月 28 日在迈阿密国际航空货运协会航空货运论坛上发布了 2026 年世界航空货运预测。该制造商预计，全球货机机队将从 2025 年的 2,395 架飞机增长到 2045 年的 4,010 架，增长 67%。
波音公司预测这 20 年间将需要交付 2,930 架货机。该公司表示，约 55% 将支持增长，其余 45% 将替换退役飞机。预计改装客机将占交付量的约三分之二，其余为新建货机。
目前，该市场包括波音 737-800 和空客 A321 等改装窄体飞机，以及大型波音 767 和空客 A330 改装飞机。新建选项包括波音 777F 以及即将推出的波音 777-8F 和空客 A350F。
该预测指出，在线购物的增长、制造地点的转移以及包括人工智能硬件在内的高价值技术的出货量将成为未来二十年的需求来源。
波音援引国际航空运输协会的数据显示，到 2025 年，超过 70% 的人工智能相关货物通过航空运输。此类运输增加了传统上依赖于运输易腐烂产品、昂贵设备和其他需要快速到达客户手中的货物的市场。
波音公司表示，尽管存在贸易争端和地缘政治干扰，2025年全球航空货运量仍创下历史新高，较上年增长近5%。在接下来的二十年里，制造商预计流量每年平均增长 3.5%。
波音公司商业营销副总裁达伦·胡尔斯特 (Darren Hulst) 表示：“航空货运的适应性和速度是战略优势，能够实现可靠的运输、动态的改道以及对不断发展的供应链的关键支持。”
他补充道：“随着全球贸易模式的变化以及对时间敏感、高价值商品的需求增长，专用货机对于全球商业仍然至关重要。”
亚洲航线预计将引领增长，约占全球航空货运市场的 60%。波音表示，随着生产在国家之间转移，以及运输中断迫使货物转移到不同的航线，航空公司正在调整其网络。
预计专用货机将继续承载全球航空货运量的一半以上。从历史上看，它们运输了大约 55%（以货物吨公里计算），而客机则在机腹舱中运输剩余的货物。
快递运营商也有望获得更大的业务份额。波音公司预测，到 2045 年，提供限时快递服务的公司将承担全球航空货运量的近 25%。
该预测是在空中客车公司于 2026 年 10 月早些时候发布的最新货运展望之后作出的，该展望将北美确定为未来 20 年货机需求的最大来源。
波音公司估计，按数量计算，空运货物仅占全球贸易量的不到 1%，但约占其价值的三分之一。
波音预计到 2045 年货运量将翻倍，对近 3,000 架货机的需求首先出现在 AeroTime 上。

body_en: British Airways adds Colombo and Melbourne in winter expansion - Aviation24.be
Home International Airlines Group (IAG) British Airways British Airways adds Colombo and Melbourne in winter expansion
British Airways has launched its winter 2026/27 programme with a new London Gatwick–Colombo service, increased capacity across 11 long-haul destinations and additional European flights.
The inaugural Colombo flight departed Gatwick on 23 October and arrived the following day. The seasonal route operates three times weekly, offering economy, premium economy and business class.

Melbourne will join the network on 9 January 2027, becoming British Airways’ second Australian destination. Flights will operate from London Heathrow via Kuala Lumpur, with four cabins, including First. The airline is also increasing capacity to destinations including Cape Town, Tokyo, Bridgetown, Kingston and San José.
On its shorter-haul network, British Airways will add frequencies to Rome, Florence, Gothenburg and Jersey. Cairo will gain seven weekly flights, taking the schedule to three daily services.

Fuerteventura flights will move from Gatwick to Heathrow, operating twice weekly from mid-December to April. Palermo becomes a year-round destination, while Thessaloniki’s season extends into November and March.

Winter leisure services include up to 110 weekly Geneva flights across Heathrow, Gatwick and London City during the peak ski season. December Christmas-market connections will include up to five weekly Heathrow–Cologne flights and four to Nuremberg.
BA Euroflyer will also introduce Gatwick–Rovaniemi twice weekly between 4 December and 4 January, complementing existing Ivalo services and British Airways’ daily Heathrow–Tromsø connection.
The winter programme also includes the planned arrival of British Airways’ first refurbished Airbus A380 and additional new aircraft.

科伦坡首航航班于 10 月 23 日从盖特威克机场起飞，并于次日抵达。该季节性航线每周运营 3 趟，提供经济舱、豪华经济舱和商务舱。
墨尔本将于 2027 年 1 月 9 日加入该网络，成为英国航空在澳大利亚的第二个目的地。航班将从伦敦希思罗机场出发经吉隆坡，设有四个客舱，其中包括头等舱。该航空公司还增加了飞往开普敦、东京、布里奇敦、金斯顿和圣何塞等目的地的运力。
在其短途航线网络上，英国航空将增加飞往罗马、佛罗伦萨、哥德堡和泽西岛的航班。开罗每周将增加七趟航班，将班次增至每日三趟。
富埃特文图拉岛航班将从盖特威克机场飞往希思罗机场，从 12 月中旬到 4 月每周运营两班。巴勒莫成为全年旅游的目的地，而塞萨洛尼基的旅游季节则延长至十一月和三月。

冬季计划还包括英国航空公司第一架翻新空客 A380 和其他新飞机的计划抵达。

title_en: FAA backs flight tests of JetZero’s top-mounted engines
title_zh: FAA 支持 JetZero 顶置发动机的飞行测试
summary: JetZero has been selected to receive $5.3 million under the fourth phase of the Federal Aviation Administration’s (FAA)… The post FAA backs flight tests of JetZero’s top-mounted engines appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: JetZero 已被选中在美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 第四阶段获得 530 万美元……美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 支持飞行测试
body_en: JetZero has been selected to receive $5.3 million under the fourth phase of the Federal Aviation Administration’s (FAA) Continuous Lower Energy, Emissions and Noise (CLEEN) program, the company announced on October 28, 2026 .

The funding will pay for engine and nacelle instrumentation on Jet1, the full-scale blended-wing-body demonstrator the Long Beach, California-based company is building ahead of a first flight it has scheduled for the fourth quarter of 2027.

According to JetZero, the instrumentation will record airflow at the engine inlet and at the fan exit during takeoff, climb, cruise and crosswind ground operations. The company said the measurements would provide data from an operating aircraft rather than relying on engine test rigs or simulated ground-plane testing. JetZero said it would share the resulting data.

The measurements target the feature that most distinguishes the design: engines mounted on top of the airframe. JetZero says that placement reduces noise for communities around airports, one of the three areas CLEEN is meant to address alongside fuel burn and emissions.

Jet1 is powered by Pratt & Whitney PW2040 engines, the model used on the Boeing 757. Under agreements announced by RTX on March 6, 2025 , Collins Aerospace is designing and building the demonstrator’s nacelle structures, including the inlet, fan cowl and fan duct.

The FAA launched CLEEN Phase IV in September 2026 and awarded two-year agreements to Boeing, GE Aerospace, Heart Aerospace, Honeywell Aerospace and JetZero. The three previous phases, starting in 2010, ran on five-year agreements and were made up largely of established airframe, engine and component manufacturers.

Heart Aerospace announced on October 12, 2026, that it had received $2.9 million for turbogenerator work on its ES-36 hybrid-electric regional aircraft , matched by an equal company contribution. JetZero did not disclose a cost share or the total value of its project.
If JetZero’s agreement runs the two-year term the FAA describes, Jet1’s scheduled first flight would leave the in-flight portion of the work in the second half of that period.

JetZero said on August 31, 2026, when it closed a $100 million loan facility , that the Jet1 build was 40% complete as of June 2026. Scaled Composites, a Northrop Grumman company, is building the aircraft. In August 2023, the US Air Force selected JetZero to develop and flight-test its demonstrator, with the Department of Defense planning to contribute $235 million toward the project over four years.

The company is targeting entry into service for the production aircraft, Z4, in the early 2030s, with final assembly planned at the factory it broke ground on in Greensboro, North Carolina , on June 15, 2026. JetZero says the Z4 is designed to be up to 50% more fuel efficient than comparable tube-and-wing aircraft using the same propulsion technology.

body_zh: 该公司于 2026 年 10 月 28 日宣布，JetZero 已被选为美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 持续降低能源、排放和噪音 (CLEEN) 计划第四阶段的 530 万美元资金。
这笔资金将用于支付 Jet1 的发动机和机舱仪表费用，Jet1 是这家总部位于加利福尼亚州长滩的公司正在建造的全尺寸混合翼身演示机，计划于 2027 年第四季度进行首次飞行。
据JetZero称，该仪器将记录起飞、爬升、巡航和侧风地面操作期间发动机入口和风扇出口处的气流。该公司表示，测量结果将提供来自正在运行的飞机的数据，而不是依赖发动机测试台或模拟地面测试。 JetZero 表示将分享由此产生的数据。
测量的目标是最有特色的设计特征：安装在机身顶部的发动机。 JetZero 表示，这种布置可以减少机场周围社区的噪音，这是 CLEEN 旨在解决燃油消耗和排放问题的三个领域之一。
Jet1 由普惠 PW2040 发动机提供动力，该型号用于波音 757。根据 RTX 于 2025 年 3 月 6 日宣布的协议，柯林斯宇航公司正在设计和建造演示机的机舱结构，包括入口、风扇罩和风扇管道。
FAA 于 2026 年 9 月启动了 CLEEN 第四阶段，并向波音、GE Aerospace、Heart Aerospace、Honeywell Aerospace 和 JetZero 授予了为期两年的协议。前三个阶段从 2010 年开始，签订了为期五年的协议，主要由成熟的机身、发动机和零部件制造商组成。
Heart Aerospace 于 2026 年 10 月 12 日宣布，已收到 290 万美元用于其 ES-36 混合电动支线飞机的涡轮发电机工作，公司也提供了同等的捐款。 JetZero 没有透露其项目的成本份额或总价值。
如果 JetZero 的协议按照 FAA 规定的两年期限执行，那么 Jet1 预定的首飞工作将在该期限的后半段完成飞行中的部分工作。
JetZero 于 2026 年 8 月 31 日关闭了 1 亿美元的贷款融资后表示，截至 2026 年 6 月，Jet1 的建造已完成 40%。诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司旗下的 Scaled Composites 正在建造该飞机。 2023 年 8 月，美国空军选择 JetZero 来开发和飞行测试其演示机，国防部计划在四年内为该项目捐赠 2.35 亿美元。
该公司的目标是在 2030 年代初期投入生产飞机 Z4，并计划于 2026 年 6 月 15 日在北卡罗来纳州格林斯博罗的工厂进行最终组装。JetZero 表示，Z4 的设计燃油效率比使用相同推进技术的同类管翼飞机高出 50%。
美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 支持 JetZero 顶部安装发动机的飞行测试，最先出现在 AeroTime 上。

title_en: MQ-9B drone tracks fighter jets at long range with Saab’s LoyalEye radar
title_zh: MQ-9B 无人机利用 Saab 的 LoyalEye 雷达远距离跟踪战斗机

body_en: General Atomics Aeronautical Systems (GA-ASI) said an MQ-9B fitted with Saab’s LoyalEye airborne early warning (AEW) radar simultaneously tracked several airborne and maritime targets at long range during flight tests in Southern California. The company announced the results on October 28, 2026.
According to GA-ASI, the airborne targets included multiple instrumented “red” fighter jets [the term for aircraft simulating an adversary -ed. note], as well as several commercial aircraft.
LoyalEye moves from first flight to multi-target tracking

The testing took place over several months from GA-ASI’s Desert Horizon flight operations facility, using a GA-ASI-produced MQ-9B with the LoyalEye radar installed in payload pods. The company did not disclose detection ranges, the number of sorties flown, or the dates of the campaign.

The trials follow the first flight of the MQ-9B with LoyalEye pods on May 19, 2026. At the time, Saab said that the flight opened a test and evaluation phase of several months, which would culminate in a full capability demonstration later in 2026.
“This has been one of the most highly anticipated flight tests we have performed,” said GA-ASI President David R. Alexander, who added that customer interest in AEW on the MQ-9B was high worldwide.
Uncrewed alternative for airborne early warning
GA-ASI said it is discussing unmanned AEW capability on the MQ-9B with several customers, but did not identify any of them or name a launch customer.

The company presents the configuration as a way to extend AEW coverage while reserving crewed AEW aircraft for missions where they are most needed. GA-ASI said battle management command and control could be performed in a distributed fashion from ground stations, ships, or existing crewed AEW aircraft, wherever the supporting infrastructure exists.

The capability is intended for the MQ-9B family, which includes the SkyGuardian and SeaGuardian, the United Kingdom’s Protector, and the MQ-9B short takeoff and landing (STOL) variant GA-ASI is developing for operations from naval aircraft carriers.

Carl-Johan Bergholm, head of Saab’s Surveillance business area, described LoyalEye as a complement to existing capabilities that adds flexibility, extends reach, and allows a more efficient use of resources.

body_zh: 通用原子航空系统公司 (GA-ASI) 表示，在南加州的飞行测试中，一架配备萨博 LoyalEye 机载预警 (AEW) 雷达的 MQ-9B 能够同时远程跟踪多个空中和海上目标。公司于2026年10月28日公布业绩。
据 GA-ASI 称，空中目标包括多架装有仪表的“红色”战斗机（模拟对手的飞机的术语）。注]，以及几架商用飞机。
LoyalEye 从首次飞行转向多目标跟踪
测试在 GA-ASI 的沙漠地平线飞行操作设施上进行了几个月，使用的是 GA-ASI 生产的 MQ-9B，并在有效载荷吊舱中安装了 LoyalEye 雷达。该公司没有透露探测范围、飞行架次或行动日期。
此次试验是在 2026 年 5 月 19 日搭载 LoyalEye 吊舱的 MQ-9B 首次飞行之后进行的。当时，萨博表示，这次飞行开启了为期数月的测试和评估阶段，最终将在 2026 年晚些时候进行全面能力演示。
GA-ASI 总裁 David R. Alexander 表示：“这是我们进行过的最受期待的飞行测试之一。”他补充说，全球客户对 MQ-9B 上的 AEW 兴趣很高。
空中预警的无人替代方案
GA-ASI 表示，正在与几家客户讨论 MQ-9B 的无人预警机能力，但没有透露其中任何客户的身份，也没有透露启动客户的名称。
该公司将这种配置作为扩大预警机覆盖范围的一种方式，同时保留载人预警机执行最需要的任务。 GA-ASI 表示，战斗管理指挥和控制可以通过地面站、舰艇或现有载人预警机以分布式方式执行，无论支持基础设施在哪里。
该功能适用​​于 MQ-9B 系列，其中包括英国的保护者 SkyGuardian 和 SeaGuardian，以及 GA-ASI 正在开发用于海军航空母舰作战的 MQ-9B 短距起降 (STOL) 变型。
Saab 监控业务领域负责人 Carl-Johan Bergholm 将 LoyalEye 描述为对现有功能的补充，可增加灵活性、扩大覆盖范围并允许更有效地利用资源。
MQ-9B 后无人机使用 Saab 的 LoyalEye 雷达远距离跟踪战斗机，首次出现在 AeroTime 上。

Home Air France KLM Group Air France Air France expands winter network and La Première rollout

Air France will increase capacity to the Americas, Asia and the Iberian Peninsula during winter 2026/27, while extending its new La Première cabin to additional US routes. The airline plans up to 725 daily flights to nearly 170 destinations in 78 countries.

North American seat capacity will rise by 6% compared with the previous winter. Paris Charles de Gaulle–Las Vegas, launched in summer 2026, will continue with three weekly Airbus A350-900 flights. Orlando will receive daily services during peak periods, while Boston will have ten weekly flights.

South American capacity will grow by 3%, with Brazil a particular focus. Rio de Janeiro will receive two daily flights from 21 December, Fortaleza will increase to daily during peak periods, and Salvador de Bahia will gain two weekly frequencies from 18 January. Santiago de Chile will be served up to ten times weekly.

In Asia, where capacity will rise by 2%, Phuket will increase from three to five weekly flights, complementing twice-daily Bangkok services. Air France will also operate twice weekly to the Maldives until early March. In Africa, Kilimanjaro and Zanzibar services will increase from five weekly to daily, while Conakry and Libreville will receive A350-900 aircraft.

The new La Première suites will be available on up to 25 Boeing 777-300ERs during the winter. Deployment includes daily Boston and Houston services, twice-daily Miami flights and, from 1 February 2027, daily New York Newark flights.
Air France says 70% of its fleet now offers its new free high-speed Wi-Fi. It expects coverage to reach 80% by year-end and the entire fleet, including regional aircraft, during 2027.

On short- and medium-haul routes, capacity to Spain and Portugal will increase by 5%. Porto will receive two daily flights, while twice-daily London Gatwick services will continue through winter alongside six daily Heathrow flights. Frequencies will also rise to Zurich, Rabat, Yerevan and several French cities.
Separately, Transavia France plans to operate 174 routes to 89 destinations in 26 countries this winter.

法航将在 2026/27 年冬季增加飞往美洲、亚洲和伊比利亚半岛的运力，同时将其新的 La Première 客舱扩展到更多美国航线。该航空公司计划每天有多达 725 个航班飞往 78 个国家的近 170 个目的地。
北美座位数将比去年冬季增加6%。巴黎戴高乐机场至拉斯维加斯航线于 2026 年夏季开通，将继续每周运营 3 趟空客 A350-900 航班。奥兰多将在高峰时段每天提供服务，而波士顿每周将有十个航班。
南美产能将增长 3%，其中巴西尤其受到关注。从 12 月 21 日起，里约热内卢将每天有两班航班，福塔雷萨将在高峰时段增加到每天两班，萨尔瓦多从 1 月 18 日起将增加每周两班航班。智利圣地亚哥每周最多提供十次服务。
在亚洲，普吉岛的运力将增加 2%，航班将从每周 3 班增加到 5 班，以补充曼谷每日 2 班的服务。法航还将每周运营两班飞往马尔代夫的航班，直至三月初。在非洲，乞力马扎罗山和桑给巴尔岛的航班将从每周五班增加到每天一班，而科纳克里和利伯维尔将接收 A350-900 飞机。
冬季期间，最多 25 架波音 777-300ER 上将提供全新 La Première 套房。部署包括每日波士顿和休斯顿航班、每日两班迈阿密航班以及自 2027 年 2 月 1 日起每日纽约纽瓦克航班。
法航表示，其 70% 的机队现已提供全新的免费高速 Wi-Fi。预计到年底，覆盖率将达到 80%，到 2027 年，整个机队（包括支线飞机）的覆盖率将达到 80%。
在中短途航线上，飞往西班牙和葡萄牙的运力将增加5%。波尔图每天将有两班航班，而每天两班的伦敦盖特威克航班将在整个冬季继续运营，此外希思罗机场每天还将有六班航班。前往苏黎世、拉巴特、埃里温和几个法国城市的班次也将增加。
另外，Transavia France 计划今年冬季运营 174 条航线，飞往 26 个国家的 89 个目的地。
